name: EPIC 248677207
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 6.2 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,960 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.91 solar masses and 6.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,151 K at its surface.
